---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / motivation

What user-facing problem does this solve? Is there a kupi.cz feature that
this maps to?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches have you thought about, and why is this one better?

## Data source

Will this require scraping something new from kupi.cz? If so:

- The URL pattern.
- A rough sketch of the HTML / data we would need to parse.

If the feature needs an external API or a database, please flag it — the
project currently has no DB and runs as a single Node instance, so any
"just add Redis" suggestion is a substantial architectural change.

## UI / design

If the change has UI implications, attach a mockup or link to an
existing screen to match.

## Translation impact

The app is trilingual (RU / EN / CS). Will this require new strings? If
so, are you able to provide all three, or do we need to stub one out and
add a follow-up?
